lead.headline: Kamara is still questionable and Dowdle is back in Pittsburgh — everyone you start is cleared
lead.deck: Tuten and Fairbairn are active in London. The flex stays Allgeier, a 12.4 coin flip with McLaurin, and McLaurin covers Monday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Alvin Kamara is questionable after three limited practices and sits behind Kendre Miller; Justin Jefferson and Ollie Gordon are on bye. In Pittsburgh, Rico Dowdle practised fully Thursday and Friday and is expected to play, so Jaylen Warren's three weeks of owning the backfield end — though Mike McCarthy still calls Warren 'our featured player', and ESPN's 15.0 already carries the change. The rest is clear. Bhayshul Tuten and Ka'imi Fairbairn are off the London inactive list; Coker, Likely and Wilson are off their final reports; Terry McLaurin got no designation. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0, against Bok-aneers' 112.5. Check the 09:30 inactives once, and Arizona's at 12:35; if Allgeier sits, McLaurin goes in.
